sources.empty: No slicer or account brings anything into the catalog yet.

source.title: Catalog source
source.hint: The system presets, brands and printer models come from one place, so a slicer update on one machine doesn't fight an older version on another.
source.label: Read the catalog from
source.none: Nothing can read this slicer's catalog yet.
source.default: Picked for you: the oldest install with a readable folder.
source.isDefault: The catalog is read from {{name}}, picked for you.
source.fromDevice: The device's connector sends this slicer's system presets whenever a slicer update changes them. Until it has, the catalog stays as it is.
source.outdated: The connector on that device is too old to send the catalog. Update it to the hub's version, then pick it again.
source.ownSlicer: Devices aren't offered: {{name}} reads this slicer's catalog here, and it's the catalog the hub slices with.
source.noWorker: To read the catalog from a device, add it as a slice worker for this slicer first.

routes.title: Where your presets come from
routes.hint: Every place your own presets come from. The first one to bring a preset keeps it.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Send presets: user presets saved in {{slicer}} on a device go to the hub within a minute. Install: the hub's presets are written to {{slicer}} on a device while it's closed, and show at its next start. A preset deleted in a slicer by the user who sent it first is deleted everywhere once nothing uses it; another user's delete changes nothing.
devices.noReport: Waiting for the device's first report.
devices.notReported: {{slicer}} is no longer found on this device.
devices.outdatedError: That device's connector is too old for a switch per slicer. Update it from Hub management, then try again.

intro.printers: Add printer brands and models by hand, or let a slicer bring them. Machine and print profiles come only from a slicer: they are its files, so you archive or delete them here and edit them in the slicer.
intro.filament: Add filament brands and materials by hand, or let a slicer bring them. Filament profiles come only from a slicer: they are its files, so you archive or delete them here and edit them in the slicer.
intro.presets: The user presets the hub's slicer and every slice worker use. A slice that used a changed preset needs slicing again.
intro.sources: What each slicer and account brings into the catalog, and when. Where they run is under Integrations.

fromFiles: From your slicer's files. Archive one to hide it from the pickers.
nameLocked: {{source}} brought this row. The next import finds it by this name, so the name can't change.
